decision.rationale: Prior working family was AR1 as provisional predictor after symmetric excitation. With staggered trial added, AR1 vs AR2 training RMSE 0.120 vs 0.115C is close, and whole-trial LOO validation 1.497 vs 1.509C both poor with slight AR1 advantage, so no evidence to revise to AR2; orders remain predictive not mechanistic. Next left-pulse gives highest D-optimal gain per parameter for improved excitation to address unresolved AR1 vs AR2 predictive ambiguity.
